# YESES SOLUTION — Web Design Studio

> YESES SOLUTION is a web design studio based in Virginia, USA. It designs fast, cinematic, custom websites for restaurants, clinics, stores and brands — no templates. Every site can be built in English, Arabic and Kurdish with full right-to-left support. Contact: khudhur@yesesofficial.com, +1 703 439 0209 (phone and WhatsApp).

## Services and pricing (USD, one-time)

- Microsite (one-page website): from $499 — ready in 3–5 days
- Business website (full multi-page site): $999 — ready in about 14 days
- Online store (e-commerce website): $2,999 — ready in up to 30 days
- Care Plan (optional, after launch): $10/month cancel anytime, or $84/year — covers updates, daily backups, security monitoring, small content edits, uptime monitoring and priority support
- Extras: online booking, photo gallery, Google Maps and reviews, WhatsApp ordering, blog, extra language, copywriting help, logo refresh (priced per project, quoted upfront)

## How it works

1. Free consultation and a free website audit for new projects
2. Design built around the business — its menu, services, photos and story
3. The client owns the website, design and code after final payment
4. Optional Care Plan keeps the site updated, backed up and monitored
